description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to handling location data in an Android app, including permission checks, location fetching, and handling location request parameters.

classes.name: LocationDataSource
classes.description: Interface for location data source, providing permission checks and location fetching.

classes.name: DefaultLocationDataSource
classes.description: Default implementation of LocationDataSource using LocationCaptureManager.

classes.name: LocationHandler
classes.description: Main class for handling location requests, permissions, and parameters.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if fine location permission is granted.

methods.name: hasCoarseLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if coarse location permission is granted.

methods.name: handleLocationGet
methods.description: Handles location request, including permission checks, parameter parsing, and fetching location.

methods.name: parseLocationParams
methods.description: Parses JSON string for location parameters like maxAgeMs, timeoutMs, and desiredAccuracy.
